title: Main Street store rota, week of 2 November 2026

constraints.rationale: Each shift gets exactly the number of people in its demand column.

provenance.quote: Every shift must be staffed with exactly the number of people listed for it in shifts.csv.

constraints.rationale: Opening shifts require the opening skill and closing shifts the closing skill; mid shifts have no requirement.

provenance.quote: Only staff trained to open the store (alarm and cash float) can work an opening shift, and only staff trained to close (cash-up and lock-up) can work a closing shift.

constraints.rationale: Default: a person cannot work two overlapping shifts (opening and closing overlap, as do mid and both).
Legal limit of 40 working hours per week.

provenance.quote: Nobody may work more than 40 hours in a week — that's a legal limit for us.

constraints.rationale: Everyone should get at least their own weekly contract hours from staff.csv (32 for full-timers, 16 for part-timers).

provenance.quote: Full-timers are contracted for 32 hours a week and part-timers for 16; please try to give everyone at least their contract hours.

constraints.rationale: At most 5 working days in a row.

provenance.quote: Nobody can work more than 5 days in a row.

constraints.rationale: Share Saturday and Sunday shifts evenly across the whole team.

provenance.quote: Weekend shifts should be shared out fairly across the team.

constraints.rationale: Chloe and Emma never work the same shift.

provenance.quote: Chloe and Emma are sisters and we never want both of them on the same shift.

assumptions.text: The store is in the UK, so shift times are local Europe/London time.
Hours are counted from the scheduled shift start and end times; breaks are not deducted.
